widgets.text: Arkham escapees lead to Sin Tzu: Scarecrow, Bane, Clayface and Sin Tzu himself. Block until the boss finishes a combo, then counter; Bane's charges are dodged by jumping, Clayface splits into blobs you clear first.
Gotham districts in sequence: the streets, Arkham Asylum, the docks, Gotham industrial areas, and Sin Tzu's stronghold.
Points from combos buy new moves and gadget upgrades between levels.
Clearing the story with each hero unlocks art and extra modes.
Each level grades your combo score; replay to buy every upgrade.
